description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FindAJob" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobApplication" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationConfirmation" name="Application confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProbationCompleted" name="Probation completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicantRating" name="Applicant rating"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies" processRef="Process_Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" sourceRef="Task_SendApplications" targetRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Application confirmation" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Catch_Confirmation" messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Potential job offer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Catch_Offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationCompleted" name="Probation completed" sourceRef="Task_Probation" targetRef="Catch_ProbationCompleted" messageRef="Message_ProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicantRating" name="Applicant rating" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="Catch_ApplicantRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Applicant">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Job applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Applicant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendApplications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportApplications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_Confirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_Offer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Probation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RatingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RateCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_OneYear</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ReviewVisible</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ApplicantRating</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RatingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Permanent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportAgain</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CompanyRating</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ContinueOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FindAJob</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Applicant" name="Job search begins"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplications" name="Write and send job applications" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Confirmation" name="Application confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Confirmation" messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Offer" name="Potential job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate a job interview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Probation" name="Complete probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RatingSplit" name="Rate after probation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_OneYear" name="One year elapsed" attachedToRef="Task_RateCompany" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewVisible" name="Company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ApplicantRating" name="Company rating received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicantRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RatingJoin" name="Ratings completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Permanent" name="Did the job become permanent?" default="Flow_NotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportAgain" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRating" name="Is the company rating C or less?" default="Flow_RatingAboveC"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContinueOffers" name="Continue receiving job offers without reporting"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FindAJob" name="Job search ends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_Applicant" targetRef="Task_SendApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_SendApplications" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Catch_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Catch_Confirmation" targetRef="Catch_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Catch_Offer" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Task_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_Probation" targetRef="Gateway_RatingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingSplit" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_RatingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingSplit" targetRef="Catch_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Catch_ApplicantRating" targetRef="Gateway_RatingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingJoin" targetRef="Gateway_Permanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Permanent" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Permanent" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRating">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobBecomesPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPermanent" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Permanent" targetRef="Task_ReportAgain"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Task_ReportAgain" targetRef="Catch_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCOrLess" name="C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="Task_ContinueOffers">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRating <= 'C'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="End_FindAJob"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Task_ContinueOffers" targetRef="Catch_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_ReviewVisibility" sourceRef="Boundary_OneYear" targetRef="End_ReviewVisible"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Companies" name="Company application handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Companies">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Companies" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ApplicationReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmReceipt</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RateApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ProbationCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RateApplicant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendApplicantRating</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_CompanyProcess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Application" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ConfirmReceipt" name="Confirm application receipt" messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ProbationCompleted" name="Probation completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProbationCompleted" messageRef="Message_ProbationCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplicantRating" name="Send applicant rating" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CompanyProcess" name="Company rating sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Task_SendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Catch_ProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Catch_ProbationCompleted" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="End_CompanyProcess"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
